name: Skywalker OG
summary: **Skywalker OG** is a [[kind:cut|cut]] that emerged from California dispensary circles in the mid-2000s. A cross of [[skywalker|Skywalker]] and [[og-kush|OG Kush]], selected and propagated as a single clone rather than sold as seed. Its exact origin grower is not documented, with different Los Angeles-area gardens credited in various accounts.
